obj.cause: The default list is created once at definition time and reused on later calls, so append_item(1) leaves [1] in that shared list and append_item(2) then returns [1, 2] instead of [2].
obj.change: Use xs=None as the default and, when xs is None, assign a new empty list inside the function before appending.
